preserved_authority_law: End-to-end qualification is a system-integration proof over existing qualified authorities, not a new Book engine or authority domain.
No predecessor exact-SHA PASS transfers to changed end-to-end harness bytes; predecessor receipts remain evidence of their own exact subjects only.
Synthetic author fixtures may exercise software gating but may not be represented as real author decisions, consent, approval or publication authorization.
Provider SUCCESS, document generation, validation, proof, accessibility PASS, provenance validation, C2PA validation or EXPORT_FROZEN status cannot independently authorize publication or delivery.
Publication/delivery remains behind an explicit recorded author/release authority boundary.
Document rendering/conversion/validation mechanics remain outside Book System and must not be duplicated in the end-to-end harness.
Prose remains a child system/evidence provider and cannot self-admit or mutate Book canonical state.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Forensically map the exact already-qualified Book parent foundations into one deterministic synthetic end-to-end authoring qualification, identify only integration seams not already proven by predecessor qualifications, and define a fail-closed matrix before writing the qualification harness.
must_prove: qualified parent foundations compose without hidden duplicate authority
exact parent/source/artifact/version identities survive cross-component handoffs
non-success, disagreement, staleness, rights/privacy and provenance states remain fail-closed across component boundaries
author-required boundaries cannot be crossed by model/provider/qualification output
one immutable release can be frozen only after technical/evidence gates
EXPORT_FROZEN cannot become PUBLISHED_OR_DELIVERED without explicit release/author authority
rollback or changed bytes invalidate stale downstream evidence and require regeneration/refreeze as applicable
idempotent replay does not duplicate canonical versions, decisions, proposals or releases
current_parent_critical_path.on_failure: Preserve the exact integration-gap finding and repair only that seam. Do not create a new engine merely to make the harness pass.

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-END-TO-END-AUTHORING-QUALIFICATION-001 beginning with the reuse-only forensic map and then, if no unresolved architecture gap exists, the deterministic integration qualification harness. Do not create real author/publication evidence from synthetic fixtures.
